Moonshine
Type: Consumable
Value: 8
Fine Value: 49
Keywords: Alcohol
Beverage
Search
Keyword: 		Global
Duration: 1000 steps
Properties:
Bankable:     Droppable:
Sellable:     Tradable:

A jar of strong alcohol that has a bit of a ghostly glow to it. The smell alone is otherworldly and threatens to inebriate you.

The Moonshine item is a consumable.

Variations

This item can be obtained in the following variations. The 'fine' consumable can be cooked by using all fine material ingredients or may be found from chests where it can replace a normal drop with a fixed rate of 1/100

Primary Recipe Output

Distill moonshine

You mix the ectoplasm into the beer and proceed to distill it. The resulting process leaves you with an extra strongly spirited drink.

A potent homemade spirit created through the distillation of combined ingredients.
